paper.title: Caloric restriction delays disease onset and mortality in rhesus monkeys.

organism.source_quote: In a population of rhesus macaques maintained at the Wisconsin National Primate Research Center, moderate CR lowered the incidence of aging-related deaths.

experiments.notes: The abstract reports no lifespan statistic, so median, mean, max and p_value are all null. Its only survival figure is a proportion alive at the time point reported — 50% of control fed animals surviving as compared with 80% of the CR animals — stated in the context of aging-related deaths. That is not a change in lifespan, and no percentage change is derived from it anywhere in this record. Secondary outcomes reported: CR reduced the incidence of diabetes, cancer, cardiovascular disease, and brain atrophy. Dose and age at onset are given only as "moderate" and "adult-onset", with no numbers. WNPRC is a colony, not a strain.
